front_door.description: No individual entrance visible from the street-side images; doors appear to be within the inner courtyard/paths beyond the carports.

access_notes: Approach is via a narrow driveway between two opposing brick carport structures with hip roofs and support posts.
Private/residents parking signage present; blue P/disabled parking signs on carport posts.
Low brick walls and pillars define the entrance to the courtyard.
No hydrant marker/standpipe plate visible at the entrance in the provided views.
Pavement level access at the driveway; a small stepped pedestrian path with metal handrail seen to the right of the carport.
obstacles: Carport roofs with support posts close to the driveway edges (width restricted).
Parked vehicles in the carports and courtyard.
Wheelie bin by the right-hand carport wall.
Low brick walls/pillars at the entrance.
rear_access_note: An internal parking courtyard and pedestrian paths are visible beyond the carports (Street View and satellite), suggesting access around the rear/sides of the blocks.
parking: Kerbside on Hanningfield Way near the entrance, or on the small paved apron immediately before the carport entrance; additional parking exists inside the courtyard beyond the carports (access via the narrow gap).
